values: Context: the site was materially redesigned recently. Use these exports for historical demand, landing-page discovery, and regression checks—not as a current rank snapshot.
• Current scale is early-stage: 17 clicks and 1,217 impressions in the six-month daily export.
• The homepage leads: 12 clicks / 1,136 impressions over six months; 4 clicks / 524 impressions over three months.
• Brand variants produced most visible query clicks; non-brand core queries generally appeared around positions 49–71.
• Protect existing landing-page signals for TikTok, Medieval, Retro, Christmas, Name, Stranger Things, compatibility, and character coverage pages.
• Do not change existing URLs, canonicals, indexability, or sitemap inclusion during the homepage phase.
• The homepage should own the generic cluster: font generator, font changer, copy-and-paste fonts, fancy text generator, and Unicode font generator.
• Re-export GSC after launch and compare URL-level clicks/impressions before starting broad inner-page edits.
